dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-intensity rings with sharp contrast transitions against a dark charcoal-colored pelage; includes a distinct closed elliptical ring on the upper-mid dorsal region and several interlocking C-shaped structures along the lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of high-intensity white speckles and small solid clusters interspersed between larger rings, particularly concentrated near the dorsal ridge transition area.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle, while a series of four prominent lateral annuli form a descending curvilinear chain toward the lower flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive reticulated pattern consisting of interlocking light-colored circles and semi-circles covering the majority of the visible mid-body lateral surface.
